g.text: Each panel has its own log y-axis range; bubble area uses one workforce scale across panels. Countries with two or fewer dated observations omitted.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #687780

g.text: All points connect within country: solid = comparable; long dashes = missing years; short dashes = definition / method change or estimate. No regional sums.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #687780

g.text: Units differ: Canada = annual labour units; Denmark = FTE; France = broad jobs before 2019, then employee FTE; Sweden = annual full-time positions. Other series use people/jobs or mixed measures.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #687780

g.text: † China: CNG company panel, scope / geography undisclosed; diamond = H1 2025 estimate. Not a verified domestic total.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #687780

g.text: Qualified points: Netherlands 2020 ≈4,000; Romania 2020 6,000+; Serbia 2021 ≈2,200+, 2022 ≈2,500+, 2023 estimated 4,300; worker location unresolved.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #687780

g.text: 19 Sep review: US history = separate ESA methods; Germany 2025–26 = revised pair. Sources and periods: region-wrap-selected-observations.csv.
